# Zakaria Dabella - Complete Portfolio Context

## Identity

Zakaria Dabella is a Full-Stack Developer, IT Support Technician, and Graphic/UI-UX Designer based in Casablanca, Morocco. His work connects software development, practical IT operations, and visual design.

He builds responsive web applications, supports technical environments, troubleshoots systems and networks, and creates brand identities and interface designs with a focus on clarity, usability, and reliable delivery.

## Professional Profile

Zakaria is a versatile Technology and Design Professional combining full-stack web development, IT infrastructure support, and visual UI/UX design. He is skilled in building responsive web applications with modern frameworks, diagnosing enterprise systems and networks, and crafting high-impact visual identities.
